answer: Sybil resistance should be bought with a bond, not a captcha. Every new identity must lock stake that vests across many epochs, so a thousand fakes tie up a thousand times the capital to earn a single round. Reputation then compounds: an ember of earned trust needs attestation from five randomly drawn established peers, and a whisper of correlated voting across a grove of young keys slashes that whole cluster's bond. Fakery must cost strictly more than it pays.
